description.p: GSExplorer+ is a dual-pane file manager built for keyboard-first work on the Linux desktop.

ul.li: Two panes with tabs, a breadcrumb path bar and a background operation queue with pause and cancel
Find Files by name, wildcard or regular expression, text inside files and office documents
Find Duplicates with content hashing and safe, reversible removal
Sync and Backup: mirror, update, two-way and hard-linked snapshot backups, with scheduling
Compress and extract ZIP, TAR and 7Z archives
Preview panel, F3 viewer and a built-in media player
Connect to SMB, SFTP, FTP, WebDAV and NFS shares; passwords stay in the system keyring

description.p: No telemetry and no automatic updates. Most of the code was written with AI assistance (Anthropic Claude) and reviewed and tested by the author.

screenshot.caption: Two panes with tabs, the sidebar and the function-key bar
About: bundled components and their licenses

description.p: First public release, renamed from GExplorer to GSExplorer+ and licensed under the GPL-3.0-or-later.

ul.li: Help, About shows the license, every bundled component with its license text, the LGPL source offer, privacy details and system information
Settings, sync profiles, schedules and saved passwords carry over from GExplorer automatically
